text: Quick decisions on waiting ideas: options as proposal children, clickable links in status comments
description:
OBSERVED 2026-11-23: the agent stuffed long text into status comments when an idea waited on Felix: draft messages, Gmail draft references, file paths, 'DECISION: (a)/(b)/(c)'. The inbox shows it as one blob; the human can't click the draft or pick an option.

Felix 2026-11-23: loves the goal (work through human-dependent ideas quickly, decide fast) but doesn't want extra data for one specific state. Shape agreed instead, using what exists:
(1) Options as child ideas: the agent adds each choice as a child of the waiting idea with status ai-proposition, its description saying what the choice leads to. Deciding = accepting one (it turns open, becomes the next work) and cancelling the others. The review inbox shows a waiting idea with its proposal children as buttons.
(2) Links in status comments, for every status: URLs and file paths render clickable, so a prepared draft or file is one click away. Display only, no new data.
The hook/MCP guidance tells agents to prepare decisions this way.

Refuted if Felix still ends up reading long comments to decide.

status.comment: 2026-11-24, Felix asked for 'tinder-like' deciding: 1–4, a number key decides and shows the next. Built: the ⧗ inbox opens in card view, one waiting idea at a time (review, human-dependent, unclear, and standalone ai-propositions; a proposal under a waiting idea is one of its options instead). Numbered options: its ai-proposition children first (choosing opens it, cancels the other proposals, hands the idea back as open with 'Chosen: …' before the old comment), then per state: review Accept / Send back… / Drop; human-dependent Done, I did it / Answer… / Drop; unclear Answer… / Drop; proposal Take it up / Answer… / Drop. Space/→ later, ← back, u undo, e edit, Tab list view. URLs in status comment and description are clickable. The MCP state description tells agents to put each answer as an ai-proposition child (packages/mcp/src/constants.ts). Code: utils/decision-options.ts, utils/link-parts.ts, utils/review-inbox.ts, components/ReviewInboxModal.vue. Verified: frontend tests 160/160 across utils, App and the inbox spec (card flow, typed answer with number keys ignored while typing, undo, list view); vue-tsc clean. Not tried in the browser yet. File paths in comments are not clickable (only web links).
